title_zh: 约好慢转展台拍摄细节

scenario.goal_zh: 确认转台速度问题并约定慢转时逐面拍摄

context_zh: 摄影师 Mira 与展品助理 Owen 在工作室为一件陶瓷展品拍照。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Mira
sentences.text: Could you rotate the display a little more slowly? The handle disappears in every photo.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: The rotation is uneven because I keep stopping at the wrong point.

sentences.speaker: Mira
sentences.text: Let it move gently, but don’t make it spin all the way round at once.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Would a quarter turn between photos work? I can hold it still each time.

sentences.speaker: Mira
sentences.text: Yes. That would let me photograph each side clearly.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: All right. Tell me when you have the shot, and I’ll turn it again.
